join_status_source: agent returned complete; normalized to Dispatch Spec terminal value completed

findings.claim: Task Session does not bind the selected live contract to the audited plan epoch.
Whole-file snapshots cannot survive intentional lifecycle/status closeout changes.
Material does not bind task, SWU, plan epoch, and unit-contract identity.
Live target bytes are not rehashed against producer baselines immediately before mutation.
Task Session does not bind the complete normalized command and receipt semantics audited by readiness.
Explicit selection is not durably bound to the audited ready frontier and current dependency state.
Missing material is indistinguishable from a plan repair and is hard-routed to Invoke Refresh.
Every mutating adapter must require a current, single-use admission receipt.

validation_impact: prove plan-once runtime-pending without mutation authority
bind selected unit and current dependencies to the semantic epoch
block wrong task, SWU, epoch, unit digest, target baseline, or semantic contract
preserve semantic epoch across status-only closeouts
keep post-execution Invoke Refresh closeout distinct
blockers: no plan-epoch binding in Task Session
residue: The goal is sound only after the named invariants are part of the design.
